submission.justification:
Based on comprehensive simulation testing, Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.492% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This represents the optimal configuration among all tested combinations:

- Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV: 92.492% efficiency (RECOMMENDED)
- Algorithm-L1 at 35 GeV: 92.162% efficiency  
- Algorithm-L3 at 30 GeV: 85.673% efficiency
- Algorithm-L2 at 35 GeV: 74.279% efficiency

The iterative topological clustering with learned calibration (Algorithm-L1) outperforms both the sliding-window clustering (Algorithm-L3) and fixed-window sum (Algorithm-L2) approaches. The 30 GeV threshold represents the optimal operating point, providing ~0.3% higher efficiency than the previously studied 35 GeV threshold while maintaining the allocated rate. Lower thresholds (25, 28 GeV) showed decreased efficiency, indicating 30 GeV is near the optimal balance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV achieves 92.492% signal efficiency, which is the highest among all tested algorithm and threshold combinations. This exceeds Algorithm-L3 (85.673% at 30 GeV) and Algorithm-L2 (74.279% at 35 GeV).

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) is explicitly listed as one of the three candidate algorithms in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: According to candidate_specs.md, all three algorithms including Algorithm-L1 fit within the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), confirming hardware deployability.
The recommended threshold of 30 GeV falls within the specified range of 20-60 GeV.
All simulations were performed at the allocated 8 kHz rate as specified in rate_allocation.md. The efficiency values reported are specifically at this rate.
